releaseNotes: Android update downloads keep their progress when MyWeek is minimised or reopened.
Dismissed installation prompts can be reopened without downloading the update again.
Recipe cards open anywhere you tap and longer recipes scroll more reliably.
View last week's meals without changing your current plan.
Ingredient gathering checklists remain available throughout guided cooking.
Settings are clearer and unnecessary recipe preparation text has been reduced.
Improved compact screens, onboarding controls and recipe filter interactions.
